arg.name: config_file
arg.description: bridge_config.yaml (CARLA, blueprint and map aliases, background vehicles)

arg.name: carla_host
arg.description: CARLA host; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: carla_port
arg.description: CARLA RPC port; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: ssv2_port
arg.description: ZMQ port SSv2 connects to; empty keeps the config file's

arg.name: background_avs
arg.description: background AVs from the config to spawn: none, all, or role names (comma-separated); empty keeps CSB_BACKGROUND_AVS, else none

arg.name: respawn_delay
arg.description: seconds before restarting a crashed bridge
